Crayon Shin-chan - Puzzle Daimaou no Naz.name: Crayon Shin-chan: Puzzle Daimaou no Nazo
Crayon Shin-chan - Puzzle Daimaou no Naz.summary: It's a puzzle game similar to Puyo Puyo with the theming of Crayon Shin-Chan, and lots of little animations and a ton of voice acting.

Yu Yu Hakusho.name: YuYu Hakusho
Yu Yu Hakusho.summary: YuYu Hakusho is a fighting game based on the YuYu Hakusho anime. The player can choose from 15 characters, each of which has their own special and hyper moves. The animation for the characters was modeled by the animation studio Pierrot who also did the TV animation.
